editor.hint.linkStart: Now click a bridge to link. Click again to cycle On / Off / Toggle.
editor.hint.linkNeedSwitch: Click a soft or heavy switch first.
editor.hint.linkNeedBridge: Link target must be a bridge.
editor.hint.linkNew: Bridge linked (toggle). Click again to change mode.
editor.hint.splitASolid: Cube A needs a solid tile, not empty or the hole.
editor.hint.splitBSolid: Cube B needs a solid tile, not empty or the hole.
editor.hint.splitDone: Split destinations set. Cubes drop onto those tiles, not extra split pads.
editor.hint.splitA: Click destination for cube A (an existing tile, not another split pad).
editor.hint.exit: Exit set. Only one exit can be placed.
editor.hint.bridgeLon: Left bridge starts ON. Click again to start OFF.
editor.hint.bridgeRon: Right bridge starts ON. Click again to start OFF.
editor.hint.switchPlaced: Switch placed. Click or drag bridges to link. Click a linked bridge again to cycle On / Off / Toggle.
editor.hint.bridgeOff: Bridge starts OFF. Click again to start ON.
boot.install: Install Bloxorz as an app. The on-screen pad overlays the stage so the playfield stays full size.
